OBSERVED_GAP: MISSION_ROTATION says 'drain old authority' but does not canonically specify that ACTIVE_INTEGRATION must be terminally reconciled and cleared before new mission-generation installation, despite integration being capable of an already-issued external Git CAS.
SAFE_INTERPRETATION_REQUIRED: Drain includes all ACTIVE_INTEGRATION phases and Git-truth reconciliation to ACTIVE_INTEGRATION == null / INTEGRATION_HEALTH == HEALTHY before G2 install.
IMPACT: Without this binding, a G1 integration may physically move the target across the G1→G2 cutover, undermining single-generation target authority and stale-intent safety.
REQUIRED_RESOLUTION: Canonically define MISSION_ROTATION drain to include ACTIVE_INTEGRATION, not only memberships/leases/tasks.
Before installing ACTIVE_MISSION_ID / ACTIVE_MISSION_GENERATION for G2, require ACTIVE_INTEGRATION == null and INTEGRATION_HEALTH == HEALTHY.

If ACTIVE_INTEGRATION is REF_UPDATE_IN_PROGRESS, COMMITTED_PENDING_VERIFICATION, REGRESSION, recovery-pending, or UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION, reconcile actual target HEAD and durable Git truth under G1 before generation cutover.
Bind the reconciled target HEAD/TREE into the mission-rotation intent/cutover preconditions so a G1 side effect cannot land after the G2 descriptor snapshot.
Add torture tests for MISSION_ROTATION racing every ACTIVE_INTEGRATION phase and crashes immediately before/after Git CAS.
